title: KPJ Healthcare Launches KPJ Care Network as Part of Transformation into One Integrated Health System
snippet:
### eReferral programme marks the first step in a connected-care journey that will be implemented progressively across KPJ
**Kuala Lumpur, 27 November 2026**– KPJ Healthcare Berhad (“KPJ Healthcare” or “the Group”), Malaysia’s largest private hospital network and the country’s first private healthcare provider to establish an Academic Health System, today launched KPJ Care Network, a key part of its transformation under the KPJ Health System (“KPJHS”).

KKPJ Healthcare is building Malaysia’s trusted integrated health system, delivering Care for Life through a connected network of hospitals and care access points. KPJ Healthcare operates 29 hospitals across Malaysia and three Ambulatory Care Centres, serving 3.3 million patients annually with 1,491 medical consultants. Beyond hospitals, KPJ Healthcare operates Klinik Waqaf An-Nur (“KWAN”) clinics, dialysis centres and mobile clinics nationwide, and offers more than 40 academic programmes at KPJ Healthcare University (“KPJU”). KPJ Healthcare has been a constituent of the Bursa Malaysia FTSE4Good Index since 2016.

title: IHH Healthcare 3Q Net Profit Rises To RM679 Mln
snippet:
# IHH Healthcare 3Q Net Profit Rises To RM679 Mln
KUALA LUMPUR, Nov 27 (Bernama) -- IHH Healthcare Bhd’s net profit rose to RM679.00 million in the third quarter ended Sept 30, 2026 (3Q 2026) from RM616.00 million in the same quarter last year.

In a statement, IHH Healthcare group chief executive officer Dr Prem Kumar Nair said the group delivered another strong performance in 3Q 2026, supported by higher inpatient and daycase volumes.

Amid rising demand, IHH Healthcare said it remained confident in its growth trajectory, underpinned by its strong clinical capabilities.

title: Bumrungrad Expands to Phuket with THB 5.4B Integrated Hospital
snippet:
Bumrungrad Expands to Phuket with THB 5.4B Integrated Hospital

# Bumrungrad Expands to Phuket with THB 5.4B Integrated Hospital
### Share
**PHUKET, THAILAND – November 2026** – Bumrungrad International Hospital is strengthening its presence in Southern Thailand through the development of Bumrungrad International Hospital Phuket, introducing an integrated healthcare model that brings its established medical expertise closer to patients while supporting regional economic growth and Phuket’s development as an international medical and wellness destination.

A defining feature of the new hospital is its **collaborative group practice model** **,** connecting medical teams across the Bumrungrad network to deliver seamless, coordinated care.

**Artirat Charukitpipat, Ph.D., Chief Executive Officer of Bumrungrad International Hospital** **,** stated, At the heart of Bumrungrad Phuket’s clinical strategy is a Hub-and-Spoke model, combining the hospital’s local medical capabilities with the multidisciplinary expertise and advanced treatment resources of Bumrungrad International Hospital.

The hospital will initially open with **118 inpatient beds** **,** with plans to add another 92 beds in a subsequent phase, bringing total capacity to **210 beds.**

The hospital is targeting a soft opening in September 2027.

Bumrungrad International Hospital Phuket is an international hospital under development, designed to combine specialist medical services, advanced diagnostics, preventive healthcare and longevity medicine from VitalLife within a single healthcare destination. With 118 inpatient beds planned for its initial phase and a total capacity of 210 beds, the hospital will operate within Bumrungrad’s integrated medical network, serving residents, expatriates and international patients across Phuket and Southern Thailand.
